data.about: A cable between two level supports carries a base load g over the whole span and an additional load q over the left part, discretised into 24 strips. The two partial resultants are hung on trial funiculars through a chosen sag point; the parallelogram of their trial poles closes at the pole whose funicular — the cable — passes through both supports and the sag point’s vertical.

steps.caption: step through with the slider, press play, or use ←/→
steps.title: How to draw this scheme

steps.caption: two level supports A (left) and B; a base load g over the whole span and an extra load q over the left part — the span is divided into 24 strips
steps.title: A cable and its loads

steps.caption: left: every strip carries its share of g (and of q in the loaded zone) — right: the 24 strip loads stacked tip-to-tail: the heavier strips make longer edges
steps.title: The load line

steps.caption: left: the q-loaded strips sum to R₁, the remaining strips to R₂, each on the vertical through its zone’s centre — right: R₁ and R₂ are the two parts of the load line
steps.title: Resultants R₁ and R₂

steps.caption: left: choose the sag point V₃ on the load boundary; strings A–W₈ and W₈–B (through V₃) bend on R₁’s line of action — right: the parallels through R₁’s ends meet at the trial pole o′₁
steps.title: Trial funicular for R₁

steps.caption: left: strings A–Z₈ (through V₃) and Z₈–B bend on R₂’s line of action — right: the parallels through R₂’s ends meet at the trial pole o′₂
steps.title: Trial funicular for R₂

steps.caption: each trial hangs from the supports: A₁, B₁ carry R₁ and A₂, B₂ carry R₂ (left) — the same four vectors close the two force triangles (right)
steps.title: Reaction components

steps.caption: right: adding the component pairs tip-to-tail — through o′₁ parallel to the o′₂-rays, through o′₂ parallel to the o′₁-rays — the parallelogram closes at the pole o
steps.title: The pole o

steps.caption: both sides at once: R = R₁ + R₂ fills the load line (right) and acts where the moments of R₁ and R₂ balance (left), dashed green
steps.title: The total load R

steps.caption: left: the cable will hang along the support tangents, which meet exactly ON R’s line of action (three-force rule) — right: the reactions run from the pole o to the ends of the load line
steps.title: Reactions

steps.caption: left: through V₃, parallel to the middle ray (grey) joining o to the division of the load line: with the two tangents this is the funicular of R₁ and R₂ alone
steps.title: The coarse funicular

steps.caption: left: from A parallel to the top ray, down to the first strip line — right: the top ray of the fan (the trial strings retire)
steps.title: The cable starts at A

steps.caption: left: at every strip line the cable bends, each new segment parallel to the next ray — right: the rays to the heavy part of the load line
steps.title: Across the q-zone

steps.caption: left: the bends flatten where the load is lighter — right: the rays to the light part of the load line
steps.title: Across the g-zone

steps.caption: left: the last segment, parallel to the bottom ray, lands exactly on B
steps.title: Landing at B

steps.caption: the cable resolves pink = tension; the length of each ray is the force in its segment — the flattest segment carries the least, the supports the most
steps.title: Tension

data.title: Drawing 15 — Cable For Non-uniformly Distributed Load
